slug: 2025-01-20 PID Appraisal Stage - Digital Zambia Acceleration Project (P505094)

facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal PID refers to Zambia's current 10,000 km of fiber optic cable, which the project aims to extend by at least 2,000 km; it does not say which regions or towns the fibre links to the capital, so this is a national fibre total only. Date is the document's published date.

systems.system: DZAP Component 1.1 Extending the backbone and regional network
systems.owner: Smart Zambia Institute (implementing agency); World Bank IDA US$20m plus US$10m commercial

note: Extension of backbone (at least 2,000 km) is an appraisal-stage plan with no contract, so no building fact; no access terms stated.
